researched.description: GeoViewer GIS asset management, field operations, and pressure monitoring software for water districts and municipal utilities
researched.notes: Site sells GeoViewer as a licensed cloud platform and names local government utilities, municipal water systems and sanitary districts as its market.

researched.description: Meter data management, utility analytics, and customer engagement software for electric, water, and gas utilities
researched.notes: Real MDM product, but the site markets to electric, water and gas providers of every ownership type and never names municipal, public power or government utilities.

researched.description: SCADA software for monitoring and controlling water and wastewater treatment, pumping, and other utility infrastructure
researched.notes: General industrial SCADA software: site lists eight markets including oil and gas, manufacturing, marine, broadcasting and food and beverage alongside water and wastewater.

researched.description: My Journey career planning, skills assessment, and case management platform for state workforce agencies, workforce boards, and schools
researched.notes: SaaS platform; site names workforce development agencies and government as primary markets, with a Virginia Board of Workforce Development customer quote.

researched.description: HIPAA-compliant client communication, scheduling, and case-note automation software for vocational rehabilitation and workforce development agencies
researched.notes: Licensed SaaS; site names state vocational rehabilitation agencies, workforce development boards and Pre-ETS programs as its market.

researched.description: Digital courtroom audio and video recording, storage, and speech-to-text transcription software for courts
researched.notes: Sells FTR Gold and FTR Justice Cloud as licensed recording products to courts; not a transcription service bureau. Site notes acquisition by Tyler Technologies in April 2026.

researched.description: No-code digital forms, approval workflow, and e-signature software for K-12 school districts
researched.notes: Site brands itself "The Document Automation Platform Built for Education" and claims 250+ school districts; FERPA compliance called out.

researched.description: Data warehouse and analytics platform that unifies SIS, LMS, assessment, and attendance data for K-12 schools and districts
researched.notes: Real K-12 data product, but site markets to schools and school groups generally with Australian Catholic and independent school references and no US public district or state education agency named.

researched.description: Automatically maintained commercial sites and buildings listing database for economic development organizations
researched.notes: Deliverable is licensed commercial real estate listing data (2M+ verified listings) syndicated into a customer's own site, i.e. a data subscription rather than software; also sold to brokers and CRE associations.

researched.description: Social program management platform for eligibility, enrollment, child welfare, and case management at health and human services agencies
researched.notes: Configurable licensed platform; site names state and local government health and human services agencies as the market, citing Minnesota, New York and Nevada deployments.

researched.description: Digital substance use disorder prevention, intervention, and recovery support platform for treatment providers, state and county health agencies, drug courts, and Medicaid plans
researched.notes: Licensed app-based platform (Connections, Companion); site names state and county government, public sector agencies, tribal governments and corrections as a primary segment.

researched.description: Behavioral health and wellbeing content, screening, and care-navigation platform deployed by public health departments, health plans, and health systems for their communities
researched.notes: What a county buys is a branded portal of curated wellbeing content across 100+ topics plus validated assessments and resource navigation - licensed material delivered through a web portal; also sold to health plans, employers and health systems.

researched.description: IEP compliance platform, universal mental health screening, and teletherapy staffing for school districts, provider networks, and state agencies
researched.notes: Core deliverable is clinical staffing and teletherapy delivered by human clinicians (500,000+ sessions, 20+ states), with the platform sold as part of a provider-plus-technology package.

researched.description: Case management EMR, outcome analytics, and revenue cycle platform for behavioral health and human services organizations
researched.notes: Real SaaS product (Advanced Metrics), but the site markets to behavioral health and human services providers of any size from small nonprofits to large enterprises and does not name government agencies as a primary market.

researched.description: Subscription American Sign Language video lesson library and dictionary for public libraries, schools, colleges, and public safety agencies
researched.notes: Instructional content subscription - 300+ video lessons and an 18,000-word video dictionary - sold per seat to institutions and individuals; a library is licensing content, not software.
